slate_extremes.label: Slate-wide single-game extremes (season/week max or argmax across games)
contract_types: season max game point differential over rung
season max game total over rung
any player single-game stat over rung in season
slate_extremes.target: Probability that the maximum (or argmax) of a per-game quantity (game margin, game total, team points, player single-game stat) across a week's or season's slate of games exceeds a threshold or falls on a named game/team.
slate_extremes.why_distinct: Requires the joint distribution of a per-game quantity over all ~16 weekly or ~272 season games and its extreme order statistic; single-game archetypes model one game, season-stat archetypes model cumulative totals, and counting specials model counts, none of which yields a slate maximum/argmax.
